name: Peter DeLuise
bio: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. Peter John DeLuise (born November 6, 1966) is an American actor, director, producer, and screenwriter, perhaps best known for directing episodes of science fiction television shows, particularly in the Stargate franchise.
